subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
A dark disc with two holes is placed on top of a dial of a watch as shown. The dark disc is now rotated so that the number 8 can be seen through one of the holes. Which of the numbers could one see through the other hole now? <image1>
Choices:
A:4 and 12
B:1 and 5
C:1 and 4
D:7 and 11
E:5 and 12
